column1: # No vectorbt counterpart yet: these rows feed the regression gate only.
# Prices follow the from_orders formula; an entry fires every entry_every bars
# (staggered by column) and its exit `hold` bars later. sl_stop/tp_stop are
# fractions, NaN disables; with either set the stop engine runs every bar.
# `features` switches on one feature against signals_both's shape (`-` for
# none): limit (limit orders 0.2% away), leverage (2x), margin (margin
# account, 10% initial and 5% maintenance margin, funding), timestop (exit
# after 7 bars). Each is measured against signals_both, which has it off.
